name: json-viewer
title: JsonViewer
description: A JSON value as a keyboard-navigable, virtualized tree or as text, in the editor's syntax colours, with a toolbar (Copy, Expand all, Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find, Tree | Text) and a context menu on every row.

manifest.name: json-viewer
manifest.title: JsonViewer
manifest.description: A JSON value as a keyboard-navigable, virtualized tree or as text, in the editor's syntax colours, with a toolbar (Copy, Expand all, Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find, Tree | Text) and a context menu on every row.
manifest.usage: Use JsonViewer to read any JSON value: a payload, an inspect result, a schema, a response, DBee's value viewer for json and jsonb cells. One component gives every place the same tools: Copy (the whole value, formatted or minified), Expand all (capped at maxExpandRows, with a message), Collapse all, Expand to depth, Find (Mod+F, in keys and values of the tree or in the text, with a count, next and previous and case), and a Tree | Text switch. Pass value (parsed) or text (parsed here; invalid JSON shows an alert with the parser's message). defaultExpandDepth sets how much is open at first. defaultMode="text" starts in Text (a request body, an event as stored); mode and onModeChange let the app remember the choice. A row has a context menu and keys: Copy value (Mod+C), Copy path in jq style such as .items[0].id (Mod+Shift+C) and Copy key (Mod+Alt+C). The tool's own buttons go in the toolbar through `actions`; do not import app code into the component. Give it a height (h-panel-sm, h-full in a sized panel): it renders only the rows in view, so large arrays stay fast. onActiveChange gives the JSON Pointer of the row the keyboard is on. Use CodeBlock for code that is not data (a command, a snippet), CodeEditor to edit JSON. Pass a stable value (memoize it): a new value object resets what is open.

props.name: text
props.description: JSON text to parse (instead of value).

props.name: defaultExpandDepth
props.description: Levels open at first; Infinity opens everything.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Called with the active row's JSON Pointer and value.

props.name: maxStringLength
props.description: Characters of a string shown in its row.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Rows rendered above and below the visible ones.

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Shown before the parser's message for invalid text.

props.name: mode
props.description: The view, controlled: the tree or the pretty-printed text. Pair it with onModeChange.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: The view at first when mode is not given.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called when the Tree | Text switch changes the view, so the app can remember the choice.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Shows the toolbar. Find stays on Mod+F without it.

props.name: actions
props.description: The tool's own buttons, at the end of the toolbar (ToolbarButtons or ToolbarGroups).

props.name: maxExpandRows
props.description: The most rows Expand all, Expand to depth and defaultExpandDepth open; a message says when it stopped there.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame; give it a height.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the tree element (null in text mode).

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame in editor.bg: toolbar, find bar, the view; data-slot="json-viewer", data-mode, data-invalid.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: role="toolbar": Copy, Expand all, Collapse all, Depth, Find, Tree | Text, then the actions slot; data-slot="json-viewer-toolbar".

slots.name: find
slots.description: role="search": the find field, the count (3 of 17), previous, next, match case, close; data-slot="json-viewer-find".

slots.name: tree
slots.description: role="tree", the scroll container of the rows; data-slot="json-viewer-tree".

slots.name: row
slots.description: role="treeitem" of size.control.xs; data-slot="json-viewer-row", data-kind, data-active, data-match, data-current-match.

slots.name: chevron
slots.description: Turns when a container opens; data-slot="json-viewer-chevron", data-expanded.

slots.name: notice
slots.description: Says how many rows Expand all opened when it stopped at maxExpandRows; data-slot="json-viewer-notice".

states.name: active
states.description: The row the keyboard is on: editor.line-highlight, and a ring while the tree has keyboard focus.

states.name: expanded
states.description: An open container's chevron, turned a quarter.

states.name: match
states.description: A row that matches Find: editor.match.

states.name: current-match
states.description: The match Find is on: editor.selection.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the tree: an inset ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: invalid
states.description: Invalid text: a color.status.danger.border frame and the parser's message in color.status.danger.fg.

accessibility: The ARIA treeview pattern: one tab stop (role="tree") with aria-activedescendant naming the active row (always rendered, even outside the window); rows are role="treeitem" with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset and aria-expanded on containers.

Keys: Up and Down move, Right opens a container then enters it, Left closes it then goes to its parent, Home and End go to the ends, Enter and Space toggle; Mod+C, Mod+Shift+C and Mod+Alt+C copy the active row's value, jq path and key; Mod+F opens Find, Enter and Shift+Enter (or F3) step through the matches, Escape closes it.
The toolbar is role="toolbar" with one tab stop and arrow keys between its buttons; the Tree | Text switch is a group of two pressed-state buttons.
Find announces its count (3 of 17) in a polite live region; a copy announces what it copied in a status region.
Keys, indices and values are text; colour (syntax.*) only repeats the kind, and strings keep their quotes. A matching row is marked by a background, and the count says where the match is.
Invalid text renders role="alert" with the parser's message.
Virtualized: only rows in view are in the DOM, so screen readers move row by row with the keys rather than reading the whole value. Text mode is a focusable, scrollable region of selectable text.
